newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Goldman Sachs ups Danish 1996 GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Goldman Sachs ups Danish 1996 GDP growth.

text.p: In its latest survey U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs on Thursday raised its expectations for Denmark's 1996 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 2.4 percent from 1.6 percent in its last forecast in September.
At the same time it upped its 1996 forecast for inflation to 2.1 percent from 2.0 percent, leaving its estimate for the current account surplus at an unchanged 10.5 billion crowns.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in October foresaw 2.0 percent GDP growth, 2.1 percent inflation, 8.9 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 10.3 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
